creator: Alexander Terp
description: muster-daemon writes its own bounded log beside its socket and streams records to a control connection that sends FollowLog (MIP-3 section 1). At the cut-over the app must: start the helper daemon without MUSTER_LOG_FILE; on every control connection send FollowLog, with no after for a Welcome instance it has not seen and with the last LogLine.number on a reconnect to the same one; append each line to the run log with a field naming the daemon; for a remote daemon, stamp its own receipt mono_ns and keep the daemon's as another field; and write a record when LogFollowed.oldest shows a gap. Remote daemons are covered by the same control connection.
title: The app follows each daemon's log into its run log
